description: This file defines the MemoryDrawing class, which extends the BaseDrawing class and handles image resources in memory, including loading from streams or strings, cloning, and identifying image MIME types. It is used for managing in-memory images within the PhpSpreadsheet worksheet component.

classes.name: MemoryDrawing
classes.description: Class for handling in-memory images in the PhpSpreadsheet library; supports loading images from streams or strings, cloning, and metadata management.

methods.name: fromStream
methods.description: Creates a MemoryDrawing instance from a stream containing image data.

methods.name: fromString
methods.description: Creates a MemoryDrawing instance from an image data string.

methods.name: setImageResource
methods.description: Sets the image resource and updates width and height properties.

methods.name: getRenderingFunction
methods.description: Returns the current rendering function used for the image.

methods.name: setRenderingFunction
methods.description: Sets the rendering function for the image.

methods.name: getMimeType
methods.description: Returns the MIME type of the image.

methods.name: setMimeType
methods.description: Sets the MIME type of the image.

methods.name: getIndexedFilename
methods.description: Generates a filename for the image based on its index and MIME type.

methods.name: getHashCode
methods.description: Generates a hash code representing the current state of the object for comparison.
